summary: Add guarded, read-after-write-verified item category-match and store assignment updates.
reason: Browser capture confirms category changes are a multipart /data/shopping-lists/update request containing two PBListOperation entries: update-list-item-category-assignment with the complete original item, followed by set-list-item-category-match-id with the complete updated item and the new match ID in originalValue (not updatedValue). Built-in Other uses match ID other even when its PBListCategory identifier is opaque. Store handlers remain add-list-item-store-id/remove-list-item-store-id with the store identifier in updatedValue. The CLI now resolves exact names or explicit match IDs from fresh metadata, previews without network access by default, requires --apply, verifies the fresh live item, and syncs the cache only after verification. Price, aisle/category-assignment subrecords beyond this captured category path, and recipe photo writes remain unsupported.
validated_outcome: Focused client tests prove the two-operation multipart category wire shape, full-item preservation, originalValue placement, exact store handler IDs, and updatedValue payloads. CLI tests prove built-in Other match-ID handling, explicit custom match-ID resolution, ambiguity rejection, verification, and offline JSON preview. No live account writes were performed in this slice; the parent agent must disposable-test --apply before treating the handlers as account-verified.
